turns.replyText:
Here’s the easiest first-time setup 🙂

Clear the area first. Once the pad is connected, it’s harder to move.
Lay out the Cushioned Rug Pad pieces according to the numbered layout for your rug size.
Connect the pieces by lining up the interlocking teeth and gently patting them until they sit flush.
Place the Rug Cover on top. Tuck each corner of the pad into the matching patented corner pocket on the underside of the cover.
Smooth the cover from the center outward so it lies flat.
Add the corner grippers after smoothing and before placing furniture. Pull the cover gently taut, then apply the grippers.

Use the Rug Cover with the included Tumble Cushioned Rug Pad. For cleaning, remove the cover from the pad before washing it. The pad can be wiped with soap and water if needed, then dried completely before the cover goes back on.

You can also follow the visual steps here: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/assembly
